build NixlKVConnectorStats from optional data dictionary for KV transfer statistics
build NixlPromMetrics from vLLM config, metric types, label names, and per-engine label values
get the required KV cache layout (HND) from vLLM config, skipping MLA models
get the number of newly matched tokens for a request during scheduling
build KVConnectorMetadata from scheduler output for KV transfer between workers
get finished receiving and sending request IDs from the Nixl connector worker
register KV cache tensors on the Nixl connector worker side
build a NixlAgentMetadata dataclass with engine_id, device_id, block sizes, and KV cache layout info
create a NixlHandshakePayload with a compatibility_hash and encoded agent_metadata_bytes for wire transfer
test the compute_nixl_compatibility_hash function with a VllmConfig, attn_backend_name, and cross_layers_blocks flag
build a RemoteMeta dataclass with block_ids, host, port, engine_id, and request_id for a remote agent
create a NixlConnectorMetadata instance and add requests via add_new_req_to_save and add_new_req_to_recv
create a NixlConnectorScheduler instance with vllm_config, engine_id, and kv_cache_config
build KVConnectorMetadata from scheduler output containing requests needing receive, save, and send
get sliding-window-clipped block IDs for each KV cache group from full block allocation
determine whether request blocks should be freed immediately or sent asynchronously on completion
create a NixlKVConnectorStats instance to container transfer performance metrics
record a successful NIXL KV cache transfer using nixlXferTelemetry data
aggregate stats from multiple NIXL connector instances into a single stats container
reduce NIXL transfer stats to a compact dict with avg, p90, and throughput values
observe NIXL transfer data and record it as Prometheus histograms and counters
create a ZMQ socket context manager with ROUTER or REQ socket type and address
test the zmq_ctx context manager for valid socket types and address binding
review the zmq_ctx context manager for proper resource cleanup on exit
summarize the _NIXL_SUPPORTED_DEVICE mapping of device types to KV buffer types
refactor zmq_ctx to merge with vllm.utils.network_utils.zmq_socket_ctx
create a NixlConnectorWorker instance with vllm_config, engine_id, and kv_cache_config for distributed KV transfer
start loading KV blocks from a remote engine by triggering non-blocking NIXL transfers
shutdown the NIXL connector worker releasing all transfer handles, agents, and registered memory
